easyPrerequisites:
You control a nontoken Merfolk that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Aphetto Alchemist exiled by Agatha's Soul Cauldron.
description:
Activate the nontoken Merfolk using Aphetto Alchemist's ability by tapping it.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Merfolk's ability, untapping it.
Repeat.
